## Economics, data, and applied research

I am an M.S. Economics student specializing in data analytics at The University of Texas at El Paso. My work focuses on using economic analysis, forecasting, and data tools to solve practical problems—especially in legal and policy settings.

## Research interests

My research interests center on applied economics, forecasting, and the use of AI and data analytics in legal contexts. I am especially interested in extending prior panel-data research on name, image, and likeness (NIL) compensation into a forecasting project that examines how the college-athlete market evolves over time.

## Skills

- **Analysis:** Econometrics, Python, Stata, Tableau, Excel, SQL, time series forecasting, panel data
- **Programming:** VBA, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- **Professional:** Legal research, litigation support, data-informed workflow design
- **Languages:** English; intermediate Spanish
